assessment_objectives.objective: Software Defined Storage (SDS), or equivalent technologies, are used to automatically enforce data access controls.
the enforced data access controls prevent access to data by unauthorized entities.
the enforced data access controls prevent access to data by entities operating from unauthorized devices.
the communities of interest between which data access is segregated within the same classification level are defined.
the enforced data access controls segregate access between the defined communities of interest for data residing within the same classification level.
